add_executable(${PROJECT_NAME})

# `aevox prepare` updates this generated file when sources change.
include("${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/AevoxSources.cmake")

target_include_directories(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/include"
    # Needed until Aevox removes its transitive internal handler include.
    "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/vendor/aevox/src"
)
target_link_libraries(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE aevox_core)
